data.title: Visions of the Unwritten - Act I: The Scent of Fresh Baked Cookies

objective1.description: Duel with Seraph at the Kitchen Threshold
objective1.dial: I protect that which matters most. Before you can see her, you must prove your intent.

objective2.description: Spar with Seraph to demonstrate conviction
objective2.dial: You never truly know someone until you fight them. Enter.

objective3.dial: Well look what the cat dragged in. Have a cookie, darling. You've already made the choice; you're here to understand why.

objective4.dial: Cinnamon and brown sugar. By the time you're done eating it, you'll feel right as rain.

objective5.dial: The Truce hasn't made this world safe, just quieter. The threads are starting to fray.
